LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 2.1.1 ARTICULATION OF WORDS AND SIGNING VOCABULARY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Activities in the Home Suggested vocabulary to be signed: clean, wash, sweep, wa
Topic 2.1: Observing and articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 2.1.1 Articulation of words and signing vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 2.1.1 Articulation of words and signing vocabulary, part of Activities in the Home Suggested vocabulary to be signed: clean, wash, sweep, wa in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why should we listen and observe attentively? 2. Why should we pronounce and fingerspell letter sounds correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and articulating signs (Listening and Speaking) 2.1.1 Articulation of words and signing vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Listening or observing skills as the learner actively listens or observe keenly and respond appropriately to

two-directional instructions.

● Digital literacy: Skill of interaction with digital devices as learners take photos and record signed video clips of activities in the home.

Values:
Responsibility: Hardwork as the learner actively engages in assigned roles and duties.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Self-esteem as the learner articulates signs of words correctly for clarity in communication.
